prompt_construction.text: A GPU executes many threads in parallel. Threads read data from memory, perform arithmetic, and write their results. Efficient inference reuses cached keys and values while generating one new token at a time.
prompt_construction.method: Repeat encoded phrase then truncate; one prompt per shape

measurement_scope.normal: Outer synchronized wall time for 32 (or --steps) growing-cache decode calls, argmax and append. Prefill, first output token, cache allocation, model loading, tokenization and initial transfer excluded; last-token projection enabled, EOS disabled. No per-component instrumentation.
measurement_scope.generation: Separate outer synchronized generate calls; includes fresh cache allocation, prefill, all output token selections and decode; steps + 1 output tokens, EOS disabled. Excludes load/tokenization/initial transfer. Both variants use last-token projection and identical validation.
measurement_scope.comparison: Only per-forward RoPE frequency sharing differs. Paired order alternates by repeat and context. Small sample, fixed prompt per shape; no confidence intervals or tail-latency claims.
measurement_scope.components: Separate intrusive runs synchronize before/after non-nested components. Includes Python dispatch and device completion waits. Residual includes SiLU, residual adds, views, Python loop and instrumentation. Not pure GPU kernel timing, and not a decomposition of normal unsynchronized execution.
measurement_scope.host_profiler: Separate first four decode steps: PyTorch CPU activity only, including host dispatch/waits on MPS. Self times are exclusive; inclusive times overlap and must not be summed. No Metal kernel timing inferred.
measurement_scope.memory: Exact allocated and valid KV tensor bytes; not allocator-reserved or peak process/device memory.
